pr_title: Fix theme updating of the inspector sections
pr_body:
Fix https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/70356

I think it's more precise version than https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/70381 (not the whole inspector tree is updating, only sections to be redrawn) and have a chance to be merged.

Also fixes few incorrect places in code.
PS: `EditorInspectorSection` seems to be an internal class, so it's safe to merge without breaking change for the users.

comments: Just FYI, I removed it from the 4.0 roadmap as this is not critical at this stage to release 4.0-stable. But if someone wants to fix it before the stable release, that's welcome of course.

Is this still expected to be fixed in 4.3? I'm using "follow system theme" on `hyprland`, and I see this for a few seconds after switching the system theme with godot 4.3:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/26305fac-b4c4-4deb-b242-fc6d0d95f95f)

review_comments: I wonder why this is exposed 🤔
Setting this here makes the `p_bg_color` argument in `setup()` unnecessary. You should remove that argument.

Removal of this from setup will lead to incorrect color until the theme changed:

For example this:
![изображение](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/3036176/101d3446-c9f5-4c25-bdef-28c76bc64e8a)

Instead of this:
![изображение](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/assets/3036176/a3feff0e-29cc-4a7c-89aa-af9c0a6e307a)

Seems like the section is added as child before setup, which is what causes this problem.
It would be nice to sort it out eventually, but for a bugfix it's safer to leave it as is.
